_doc: Persistent supervisor state for the Work-PC autonomous QA node. Survives Claude process crashes, supervisor crashes, and Windows restarts - a fresh Fable QA Director invocation reads this FIRST to decide what to do, with zero dependence on conversational memory. NEVER contains secrets, tokens, cookies, storageState, or credentials.
next_action: WAITING_FOR_HOME_PC. Do not resume Phase B. Re-entry requires: Home PC deploys the invitation/delivery fix AND the exact deployed WEB_SHA is known, then SERIAL W1 with the full required-proof set (see qa/home-pc-handoff/HOMEPC-2026-09-10-BUG-036-invitation-delivery.json). Parallel browser lanes remain BLOCKED regardless until Phase D isolation proofs pass.

resource_governor._doc: Operational safeguards. These bound cost/load; they must NEVER silently reduce coverage. If a limit pauses QA the status is PAUSED_RESOURCE_LIMIT and remaining work stays QUEUED - never reported as VERIFIED.
resource_governor._max_concurrent_note: Starting conservative at 3 (not the charter's 4-8 ceiling) and benchmarking first. Since 2026-09-10 workers are CLASS-POLICED: SOURCE_AUDIT workers run read-only (Read/Glob/Grep) from a detached source-only worktree; BROWSER_QA workers exist only with a dedicated synthetic identity (own auth user, own synthetic org, own isolated profile) and are BLOCKED until Phase B-D bootstrap + isolation proof. No worker ever runs as the founder identity. Fixture-namespace discipline plus identity/org leases prevent cross-worker contamination.

authentication._doc: No secrets stored here. Records only WHICH mechanism is in use so a recovering session knows what to check.
